Splitting #214 and #218 fails check_tauri_versions.py exact plugin version pairing; #217 touches .github/workflows/** without an operational trace; and cherry-picking #216 fails cargo check --locked with 12 E0599/E0308 errors because sysinfo 0.40 changed System::new, System::new_all, System::os_version, and System::kernel_version to return Result<_, sysinfo::Error>, while lib.rs .manage(Mutex::new(System::new_all())) silently changed the managed state type from Mutex<System> to Mutex<Result<System, Error>>.
